name: Sheen Card
description: A portrait card that tilts slightly while a band of glare slides across it with the pointer, like light on ice.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Largest tilt on each axis, in degrees.

props.name: glare
props.description: Strength of the glare band, from 0 to 1.

props.name: sheen
props.description: Adds a faint cyan-to-violet sheen under the glare that shifts with the angle.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element. Set the card's width here; the height follows at 3:4.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content. The card is relative and clips its children, so absolutely positioned images can fill it.
